description: Source code for the SMSCenter class in the ERPNext system, handling SMS recipient list creation and message sending.

classes.name: SMSCenter
classes.description: A class representing the SMS center functionality, including creating recipient lists and sending SMS messages.

methods.name: create_receiver_list
methods.description: Generates a list of receiver contact details based on the selected contact type and filters.

methods.name: get_receiver_nos
methods.description: Extracts and returns a list of receiver phone numbers from the receiver list.

methods.name: send_sms
methods.description: Sends an SMS message to the list of receiver phone numbers if message content is provided.
